public_cli_default: inactive; no numeric imports or input data reads until --execute plus a matching enabled root release
presets_and_optimization_source: Exact fixed choices from sealed native PROTOCOL.json; these are our prospective configurations, not an author-winning configuration
checkpoint_rule: Largest full-validation AUROC; exact AUROC ties use lower validation NLL, then earlier epoch. Save and restore the selected state. Never evaluate TEST in the loop.
architecture_rule: Largest mean selected validation AUROC across three seeds; exact ties use lower mean validation NLL, fewer native active parameters, then config id. Select once using native singles only.
exposure_classification: ordinary Tolokers is an original paper benchmark; NSD/MLP screen is exploratory
graph: Complete official Tolokers graph, official split0, every TRAIN and VALIDATION row; numeric roles must be supplied by root-authorized exporter
support: Compute actual row-sorted unique directed reverse-paired support by the inspected PyG2.6.1 to_undirected/coalesce semantics; raw/expanded/canonical counts are recorded. No guessed directed edge constant is enforced.
test_truth: No full y/test_y or TEST truth arrays accepted by runner; reject unknown archive keys before reading arrays. Exporter reads only local official raw archive and emits TRAIN/VALID truth only.

mlp.optimizer: same Adam .01/.0005, max500/patience200 and validation selector
mlp.label_opportunity: all same TRAIN labels; all same VALIDATION rows for selection; no topology input
mlp.information_difference: Native additionally uses complete graph support; MLP is a feature-signal competence anchor, not a same-information transport control

checkpoint_restore.owned_file: SELECTED_STATE.pt; state dict, optimizer, CPU/CUDA/Python/NumPy RNG state and TRAIN/VALID selected logits only
checkpoint_restore.load: weights_only=True on a checkpoint produced by this same fresh output attempt, map_location=cpu
checkpoint_restore.report: Fresh original constructor or MLP constructor, strict selected-state load, exact parameter/buffer equality, new TRAIN/VALID metrics

rng_ownership.per_baseline_fit: Fresh seed-owned model and optimizer; base seed initializes Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/all visible CUDA streams and continues into training
rng_ownership.evaluation: Snapshot all owned RNG states, seed base+2000003+epoch, one full forward, restore training RNG states afterwards
rng_ownership.native_detail: Dropout may consume device RNG; original FloatTensor SVD jitter consumes CPU RNG even for CUDA models
rng_ownership.independent_future: Separate complete native models, optimizers and unscaled own NLL; member seed base+1000003*member. Save/restore each member stream rather than interleave a pooled optimizer shortcut. Native/independent constructor index preprocessing remains charged.
rng_ownership.shared_joint_future: One bank-owned ordered CPU/CUDA training stream, frozen member traversal, private factors captured in model state; full M native paths. Unit factors do not guarantee useful diversity. Joint includes its readout optimizer group.
rng_ownership.assignment_future: Fixed seeds/buffers from immutable adapter; resampled global RNG is owned by bank training/evaluation contexts. Exactly one draw per member/layer/forward; no implicit eight-draw selection/serving.
rng_ownership.resume_future: After fresh construction and strict model/optimizer loading, restore checkpoint RNG before continuing; report-only baseline reconstruction uses the recorded evaluation stream. Other family loops are not implemented/launched in this packet.

failure_policy: All 15 scheduled fits have records. Retain failures, partial histories and owned selected states. No architecture freeze if any scheduled native or MLP fit fails; no hidden seed/config replacement.
competence_policy: Same native/MLP provisional numerical criteria from prior PROTOCOL. Largest native mean validation AUROC across three paired seeds, NLL/parameter/config-id tie breaks. Passing numerical gates still requires root learning-curve/stability review before freezing. Weakness requires prospectively documented <=4 full-task amendment; no silent grid or test tuning.
cost: Actual unique active parameters, constructor time/topology storage, actual native saved-map payload formula, every train/validation/restored forward count, checkpoint cost, full attempt time, CUDA peaks and cumulative process CPU RSS. Failures retained. MLP device topology tensor is released; host role archive remains resident, so CPU RSS is cumulative process high-water rather than isolated family peak.
future_release: Root must audit exposure/roles and qualify runtime/native numerical behavior; bind exact source seal, input archive/role metadata hashes, fresh output path, final device, runtime versions and deterministic policy in an enabled release. No installs, downgrades, source rewrites or server actions occur here.

native_placement.method: Original CPU constructor and topology preprocessing, then explicit transfer before forward
native_placement.guard: Original CPU/float32 learned initialization, unchanged canonical edge order/content, model-builder graph identity, no plain tensor left on another device; no bank device move afterward
native_placement.root_qualification_required: Exact index values and eval/train/gradient parity against direct final-device native construction with synchronized RNG; no qualification run here
native_placement.reason: Avoid millions of CUDA scalar reads in original dictionary pairing while retaining source construction arithmetic
